block.ruinatlas.ancient_book_casket.open: The lid falls open and years of rubbings slide out into the dust.
block.ruinatlas.boundary_stele.text: The boundary stele reads: within this border there once were kingdoms. Now grass covers the road and no one guards it.
block.ruinatlas.cangyin_gate_stele.enter: The stele shudders and the wild road opens before you. You have stepped into the Cangyin Ruin Realm.
block.ruinatlas.cangyin_gate_stele.retur: The stele flickers and you are back on familiar ground.
block.ruinatlas.cangyin_gate_stele.text: The Cangyin gate stele lies across the wild road. On its back someone carved: guests may come, the departed leave no name. A smaller line reads: sneak and touch the stone again to cross into Cangyin.
block.ruinatlas.spirit_platform.text: The spirit patterns on the stone are long faded, leaving only a shallow hollow where spirits were once drawn.
block.ruinatlas.spirit_test_altar.result: Breath drawn and measured... aptitude for cultivation: 0. This body has no foundation to carry the way.
block.ruinatlas.waystone.text: The waystone records an old mileage: three li to the town, seven to the post. Half the strokes are worn away.
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.already_learne: This form is already in your book; the niche takes no second scroll.
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.bead_blessed: The will settles on your copper bead: %s spirit-free cast(s).
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.bead_full: The bead already holds %s strands of will. Spend them first.
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.blessing: The relic sinks into the niche and is folded into spirit +%s (now %s).
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.hint: The niche has stood empty. A scroll is unrolled for you, a copper bead takes one spirit-free cast, and rubbings, pendants or jades fold into spirit.
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.learned_scroll: The lingering will unrolls it for you: "%s" is recorded, at no cost of spirit.
block.ruinatlas.xun_niche.rank_filled: The lingering will renews your trace: "%s" is brought straight to completion.
item.ruinatlas.banner_shard.effect: The faded banner washes away the foulness: +%s spirit (%s left).
item.ruinatlas.breath_jade.effect: The jade breaks and breath is hidden: +%s spirit (%s left). Strike once and the concealment is gone.
item.ruinatlas.calming_bone_tally.effect: The tally presses the curse back: +%s spirit (%s left).
item.ruinatlas.crush_charm.tooltip_detai: Spirit is no status effect, only fuel for understanding and casting. Crushing destroys the relic.
item.ruinatlas.glow_spar.effect: The spar draws light: +%s spirit (%s left). When the light ends, the crystal is gone.
item.ruinatlas.hemp_robe.tooltip: Coarse hemp cloth, barely enough to cover the body. Right-click to wear it, right-click again to take it off.
item.ruinatlas.mountain_tile.effect: The tile carries the weight of the mountain: +%s spirit (%s left). Your steps are steady and falls are spared.
item.ruinatlas.reusable_talisman.drawn: The talisman paper burns a thin bright line. For an instant an old spell is drawn into you.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_copper_bead.cast: A stir of spirit, and "%s" follows your thought.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_copper_bead.empty: The copper bead spins on nothing — you have not understood a single form.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_copper_bead.failed: The form did not take. No spirit was spent.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_copper_bead.no_spi: This form needs %s spirit; you have only %s.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_copper_bead.switch: The copper bead now points to "%s". Sneak-use to change it again.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_copper_bead.toolti: Hold it to aid casting: spirit and cooldown both reduced by a fifth.
Forms do not need this bead to be cast; a thought is enough. The bead is only an aid.
item.ruinatlas.spirit_holding_stone.effe: The stone crumbles and spirit rushes in: +%s spirit (%s left). When it fades you are still the one with no foundation.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.burnt: The spirit-paper burns away. "%s" is complete; this scroll is spent.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.deepen: The trace deepens: "%s" now stands at %s.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.first_re: The marks settle into your eyes: "%s" is first understood. Study it again to deepen the trace.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.full: Its trace is already full; studying it again gains nothing.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.learn: "%s" is now recorded in your book of techniques.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.learned: This form is already recorded. No need to learn it again.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.no_spiri: The marks on the scroll are only strokes. Borrow spirit first, then the technique can be understood.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.rank_lin: Three layers of trace: First Trace · Trace Settled · Trace Complete; a complete scroll burns itself.
item.ruinatlas.technique_scroll.tooltip: Right-click to understand: 1 spirit for the first trace, 3 spirit for each deeper layer.
item.ruinatlas.wind_shell_pearl.effect: The pearl stirs the flowing wind: +%s spirit (%s left).
ruinatlas.configuration.title: Ruin Atlas Configs
screen.ruinatlas.wheel.empty: No scroll has been understood yet.
screen.ruinatlas.wheel.hint: Click a form to make it the current one.
technique.ruinatlas.cast.cooldown: "%s" has not settled yet. Wait a moment.
technique.ruinatlas.cast.failed: "%s" did not take; the spirit was returned.
technique.ruinatlas.cast.no_spirit: This form needs %s spirit; you hold only %s.
technique.ruinatlas.cast.not_learned: This form is not yet understood. Find its scroll first.
